import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem nested_real_root_of_sq_eq (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hsq : a ^ 2 = 64) :
  (16 * (a ^ 2) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3)) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) = 4 := by
  have h₁ : a = 8 ∨ a = -8 := by
    have h₂ : a = 8 ∨ a = -8 := by
      apply or_iff_not_imp_left.mpr
      intro h₃
      apply eq_of_sub_eq_zero
      apply mul_left_cancel₀ (sub_ne_zero.mpr h₃)
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a - 8), sq_nonneg (a + 8)]
    exact h₂
  
  have h₂ : a = 8 := by
    cases h₁ with
    | inl h =>
      exact h
    | inr h =>
      have h₃ : a ≥ 0 := ha
      have h₄ : a ^ 2 = 64 := hsq
      have h₅ : a = -8 := h
      nlinarith
  
  have h₃ : (a ^ 2 : ℝ) = 64 := by
    rw [h₂]
    <;> norm_num
  
  have h₄ : ((a ^ 2 : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3)) = 4 := by
    rw [h₃]
    
    have h₄₁ : (64 : ℝ) > 0 := by norm_num
    
    rw [show (64 : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) = 4 by
      
      have h₄₂ : Real.log (64 : ℝ) = 6 * Real.log 2 := by
        
        have h₄₃ : Real.log (64 : ℝ) = Real.log (2 ^ 6) := by norm_num
        rw [h₄₃]
        
        have h₄₄ : Real.log (2 ^ 6 : ℝ) = 6 * Real.log 2 := by
          rw [Real.log_pow] <;> ring_nf <;> norm_num
        rw [h₄₄]
      
      have h₄₅ : (64 : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) = Real.exp ((1 / 3 : ℝ) * Real.log 64) := by
        rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 64)]
        <;> ring_nf
      rw [h₄₅]
      
      have h₄₆ : Real.exp ((1 / 3 : ℝ) * Real.log 64) = Real.exp ((1 / 3 : ℝ) * (6 * Real.log 2)) := by
        rw [h₄₂]
      rw [h₄₆]
      have h₄₇ : Real.exp ((1 / 3 : ℝ) * (6 * Real.log 2)) = Real.exp (2 * Real.log 2) := by
        ring_nf
      rw [h₄₇]
      have h₄₈ : Real.exp (2 * Real.log 2) = (Real.exp (Real.log 2)) ^ 2 := by
        rw [show 2 * Real.log 2 = Real.log 2 + Real.log 2 by ring]
        rw [Real.exp_add]
        <;> ring_nf
        <;> field_simp [Real.exp_log, Real.exp_log]
        <;> ring_nf
      rw [h₄₈]
      have h₄₉ : Real.exp (Real.log 2) = 2 := by
        rw [Real.exp_log (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
      rw [h₄₉]
      <;> ring_nf
      <;> norm_num
    ]
  
  have h₅ : (16 * (a ^ 2 : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3)) = 64 := by
    rw [h₄]
    <;> norm_num
  
  have h₆ : (16 * (a ^ 2 : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3)) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) = 4 := by
    rw [h₅]
    
    have h₆₁ : (64 : ℝ) > 0 := by norm_num
    
    rw [show (64 : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) = 4 by
      
      have h₆₂ : Real.log (64 : ℝ) = 6 * Real.log 2 := by
        
        have h₆₃ : Real.log (64 : ℝ) = Real.log (2 ^ 6) := by norm_num
        rw [h₆₃]
        
        have h₆₄ : Real.log (2 ^ 6 : ℝ) = 6 * Real.log 2 := by
          rw [Real.log_pow] <;> ring_nf <;> norm_num
        rw [h₆₄]
      
      have h₆₅ : (64 : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) = Real.exp ((1 / 3 : ℝ) * Real.log 64) := by
        rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 64)]
        <;> ring_nf
      rw [h₆₅]
      
      have h₆₆ : Real.exp ((1 / 3 : ℝ) * Real.log 64) = Real.exp ((1 / 3 : ℝ) * (6 * Real.log 2)) := by
        rw [h₆₂]
      rw [h₆₆]
      have h₆₇ : Real.exp ((1 / 3 : ℝ) * (6 * Real.log 2)) = Real.exp (2 * Real.log 2) := by
        ring_nf
      rw [h₆₇]
      have h₆₈ : Real.exp (2 * Real.log 2) = (Real.exp (Real.log 2)) ^ 2 := by
        rw [show 2 * Real.log 2 = Real.log 2 + Real.log 2 by ring]
        rw [Real.exp_add]
        <;> ring_nf
        <;> field_simp [Real.exp_log, Real.exp_log]
        <;> ring_nf
      rw [h₆₈]
      have h₆₉ : Real.exp (Real.log 2) = 2 := by
        rw [Real.exp_log (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
      rw [h₆₉]
      <;> ring_nf
      <;> norm_num
    ]
  
  apply h₆

theorem nested_real_root_of_sq_eq (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hsq : a ^ 2 = 64) :
  (16 * (a ^ 2) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3)) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) = 4 := by

    rw [← Real.rpow_mul h64]
    norm_num
  
  have hroot : (64 : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) = 4 := by
    have hc := hcube
    norm_num [Real.rpow_natCast] at hc
    nlinarith [

        Real.rpow_nonneg h64 _
    ]
  
  rw [hroot]
  
  have hbase : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 16 * 4 := by
    norm_num
  
  have houter : ((16 * 4 : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3)) ^ (3 : ℝ) = 64 := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_mul hbase]
    norm_num
  
  have ho := houter
  norm_num [Real.rpow_natCast] at ho
  
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ (16 * 4 : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) :=
